blurb: Welcome to Fly Seaside Helicopter Tours, an FAA Certified Air Carrier operating under a 91.147 Authorization. Your safety is our priority, and we strive to exceed FAA standards to ensure you’re always in great hands. While we specialize in aerial tourism, we also offer helicopter support services for various applications, including photo video shoots, aerial surveys, and wildlife surveys.
